description: The donut-style pie chart titled “Stimulus Type” depicts the distribution of input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, and it contains 9 labeled slices. The slices are: Draft/Other in dark red at about 26.4%; Press Release in mustard yellow at about 18.7%; External News Article in dark green at about 18.1%; Interview in dark navy at about 8.8%; Organizational Report in purple at about 7.7%; Event Posting in dark maroon at about 6.6%; Organizational Website in light lavender at about 4.9%; Intra-agency news article in medium blue at about 4.9%; Email in light green at about 2.7%; and Social Media Post shown as a very thin orange sliver at about 1.1%. Percentages are printed alongside the category labels outside the ring, there is no separate legend, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise emphasized; the segments appear arranged around the circle without an explicit monotonic ordering by size.
caption_used: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of various input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs during WildChat conversations, matched to online articles from two identified news agencies. The largest category is 'Draft/Other,' accounting for approximately 26.4% of the total, followed by 'Press Release' at 18.7%. 'External News Article' and 'Interview' are the next largest categories, representing 18.1% and 8.8%, respectively. Notably, 'Organizational Report' consistently exceeds 'Event Posting,' with 9.7% compared to 6.6%. Additionally, 'Social Media Post' shows a slight increase over 'Email,' with 1.5% versus 2.7%. The chart provides a clear overview of the relative proportions of each stimulus type, with all categories labeled and color-coded for clarity.
